description: Upload PDFs, create interactive flipbooks, manage collections, and track engagement analytics directly from Chat GPT. Turn static documents into shoppable catalogs, digital magazines, brochures, and reports with embedded videos, links, and lead forms. Pull view stats, reader behavior, and conversion data into your conversations to inform content decisions. Make Flipsnack a native part of your publishing workflow, from creation to performance analysis, without leaving Chat GPT.
